mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE m.status = '0' AND r.status = '0' AND ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.status = '0' AND r.status = '0' AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE m.status = '0' AND rm.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
